title: The panel-change operation, its fields, the table code, the record code, the compensation, the screen and two owner contracts are not in the sources
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E8-012); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P4 Access and administration v3.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P4 Access and administration v3.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3.md; _work/msr/context/P4.md; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/RWB-ITG-W4 Wave 4 integration/RWB ITG E8012 ITG Publish a panel change - integration v1.md
description: Six values of the publish slice are not in the sources: the two operations of the panel change (POST /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/panel-changes and its read) and their fields, since the ownership map gives rwb-access four provided operations and none of them is a panel change; the reference table code the file is handed to the owner under (partner_panel); the C dependencies the story needs on the P3 reference-load contract and the P7 rule-package contract, while the metadata contract-dependency list carries only RWB-P3-E1042-CON; the record code the publish is written under in the local decision-record chain; the compensating rollback that makes legacy AC2 true when the record cannot be written; and the screen that carries a panel change, since the legacy story names SCR-39 Rules and parameters and SCR-41 Delegation of authority and neither carries a panel.
evidence: RWB-E8-012 names two endpoints, POST /admin/rule-versions and POST /admin/rule-versions/{versionId}/approve, which are the rule package registry's under ASM-A6-api-3 and are not a panel operation; its data table names partner, decision_log_entry, rule_row and role and no panel table. FSD P4 v3 A2.23 gives the intent, the measure, the three-step journey, VR-P4-023-1, BR-P4-023 and the two roles, and no operation, no field of the change and no screen state; BR-P4-023 only says that no value a business person may change is written in code. TSD P4 v3 T-A.1 lists API-P4-004 to API-P4-021 and none of them is a panel change; its reference-load operations are P3 rwb-case's under ASM-A6-api-4 and its rule-package operations are P7 rwb-decision's under ASM-A6-api-3. The context pack gives P4 five tables (delegation_limit, masking_rule, permission, role, role_conflict), four provided operations, no event, one job (JOB-18) and no workflow, so neither the partner master nor the panel rows nor a rule table can be this service's. The Epics 3 to 8 specification gives FEAT-ADM-07 with FEAT-PRM-02 as its dependency, and FEAT-PRM-02 (E6, S9) holds the panel and the fee schedule as versioned reference data; the integration story RWB-ITG-E8012-ITG names a slice RWB-S9-E8012-APP that _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json does not carry for RWB-E8-012 (its three slices are RWB-P4-E8012-CON, RWB-P4-E8012-APP and RWB-ITG-E8012-ITG).
proposed: Provide the publish and its read under the access base as POST and GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/panel-changes, hand the workbook unchanged to the P3 reference-load operation with the table code partner_panel and validFrom, read the rule version from the P7 rule-package contract and accept only APPROVED or IN_FORCE, record one entry of the local decision-record chain under the library's administrative-change code, compensate a failed record with the owner's rollback and raise one incident where that fails, serve the pane through SCR-40 Reference data via RWB-PLT-N001-CON, and raise the two missing C dependencies at D1 without adding them to the metadata.

title: The change schema, the closed state sets, the table code, the refusal shape and the field-level load answer are not in the sources
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P4 Access and administration v3.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P4 Access and administration v3.md; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E8-012); _work/msr/context/P4.md
description: Five values of the contract baseline are not in the sources: the field set of the change and of its answer (changeId, partnerType, panelVersion, effectiveFrom, rulePackageCode, ruleVersion, loadId, loadState, state, recordedAt, breakGlassUntil, inForce); the one state of a change (fixed here as PUBLISHED) and the mapping of the load state and of the accepted rule-version state onto the only state set the module specification gives; the table code partner_panel as a closed constant of the write; the message and the shape of the owner's refusal of a load, since the agreed text of MSG-GEN-004 is 'Someone else changed this record' and no refusal text exists; and the field-level shape of the load the owner answers beyond the fields the change declares.
evidence: TSD P4 v3 T4 gives a lifecycle for a rule package version only (LOADED, VALIDATED on a passed load, APPROVED by a second person, IN_FORCE from the valid-from date, SUPERSEDED, ROLLED_BACK, REFUSED on a failed check) and T3.2 gives LOV-VERSION-STATUS with the same seven values; the module specification gives no state for a reference load and none for an administrative change. TSD P4 v3 T-A.2 gives RulePackage[] and RulePackageVersion[] answers and no PanelChange schema; API-P4-005 takes a multipart file with table and validFrom and answers ReferenceLoad, and the ReferenceLoad field list is not in the extract. FSD P4 v3 A2.23 names three data entities (partner, decision_log_entry, rule_row) and a role and permission field catalog, and no field of the change itself. The legacy message table gives MSG-P4-001, MSG-P4-002, MSG-P4-004, MSG-GEN-001 and MSG-P7-003 and no message for a load the owner refuses.
proposed: Fix PanelChange and its answer in RWB-P4-E8012-CON as the contract slice states them, close the change state to PUBLISHED, draw loadState and the accepted rule-version states from LOV-VERSION-STATUS of TSD P4 v3 T3.2 and T4, fix partner_panel as the table code, map an owner refusal to 409 with MSG-GEN-004 plus loadRefusal, and confirm the field-level ReferenceLoad answer and the refusal shape with the rwb-case owner before the baseline is tagged.

title: The legacy right of the panel change and the capability area of the technical specification disagree on who publishes it
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E8-012 permission checks); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P4 Access and administration v3.md T6.1; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P4 Access and administration v3.md A2.23.3.3; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3.md (FEAT-PRM-02)
description: The legacy story puts the publish in Rules and parameters with the C letter held by RW-COE and the A letter by RW-RISK, while the module specification puts the panel rights in Reference data, where RW-AGENCYMG, the primary role of the feature, holds R and U only, RW-REFADM holds CRUD, RW-COE holds CRUD in both areas and RW-RISK holds RA in Rules and parameters. The two sources therefore disagree on the capability area of the publish and on whether the primary role of the feature may publish at all.
evidence: RWB-E8-012 permission checks: Rules and parameters C, RW-COE; Rules and parameters A, RW-RISK. TSD P4 v3 T6.1: RW-AGENCYMG holds R in Rules and parameters, RU in Reference data and - in Platform administration; RW-REFADM holds R and CRUD and -; RW-COE holds CRUD, CRUD and R; RW-RISK holds RA, R and -. FSD P4 v3 A2.23.3.3 names the partner and agency manager as primary and the reference data administrator as also-user; the Epics 3 to 8 specification gives FEAT-ADM-07 the Workbench and the Partner portal and FEAT-PRM-02 to the reference data administrator. Template and Rules R3 puts the technical specification above the story master.
proposed: Read the publish on Reference data C and the read on Reference data R under the R-PREC order, keep the A letter with the approval of the load (RWB-P4-AD010-APP) and of the rule version (rwb-decision) and not with this operation, and let the matrix decide whether the partner and agency manager publishes or only prepares: a role that needs the C letter gets a permission row and not a release.
